description.zh: 以对话为单位组织消息的页面：左侧会话列表按最新消息排序，右侧线程区按时间正序铺气泡， 底部输入框承担发送与附件，顶部显示对方状态与操作。 它把异步沟通的上下文留在同一条线程里，适合客服、社区与团队协作场景。
description.en: A page organized around conversations: a session list sorted by latest message, a chronological bubble thread and a composer for text and attachments.

use_when.zh: 需要一对一会话或小组实时沟通
消息要保留上下文并能回看历史
use_when.en: Messages must keep context and support history lookup

use_when.zh: 客服、社区或团队协作的持续对话
use_when.en: Ongoing support, community or team conversations

avoid_when.zh: 只是单向广播或公告（用通知中心或横幅）
avoid_when.en: One-way broadcasts — use a notification center or banner

avoid_when.zh: 内容需要结构化比对（用表格或看板）
avoid_when.en: Content needs structured comparison — use a table or board

avoid_when.zh: 少于三条消息的临时确认（用内联提示即可）
avoid_when.en: One-off confirmations under a few messages — inline hints suffice

note.zh: 会话列表 + 线程，桌面主形态
note.en: Conversation list plus thread, the desktop default

note.zh: 只显示当前对话，移动端常用
note.en: Only the current conversation, common on mobile

note.zh: 群聊式连续气泡，强调发言者
头像、名称、最后一条摘要与未读徽标，按最新消息排序。
note.en: Avatar, name, last-message snippet and unread badge, ordered by latest message.

note.zh: 对方名称、在线状态与更多操作，移动端可返回列表。
note.en: Peer name, presence and more actions; returns to the list on mobile.

note.zh: 左右区分己方对方，尾部带时间与已读状态。
note.en: Left/right distinguishes sender, with time and read state at the tail.

note.zh: 按天插入分隔，避免长线程失去时间感。
note.en: Day dividers keep long threads from losing their sense of time.

note.zh: 多行输入 + 附件 + 发送按钮，回车发送可配置。
note.en: Multi-line input plus attachments and send, with configurable Enter-to-send.

notes.zh: 左右两列用 grid-cols-[280px_1fr]，移动端折叠为单列并让线程占满。线程区正向排列、 发送后滚动到底（scrollIntoView），历史加载保持滚动位置锚定。气泡最大宽度约 72%， 输入框用 textarea 自动增高；乐观发送先插入本地气泡，失败再标记重发。
notes.en: Two columns via grid-cols-[280px_1fr], collapsing to a single stacked column on mobile. Keep the thread in chronological order and scroll to the end on send (scrollIntoView), anchoring scroll position when loading history. Cap bubbles near 72% width, auto-grow the textarea, and use optimistic sends that mark a retry state on failure.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group — Chatbots and conversational UI
W3C WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices — Feed pattern

basic.zh: 创建一个聊天消息页，包含会话列表、消息线程和输入框。
basic.en: Create a chat page with a conversation list, a message thread and a composer.

design.zh: 创建团队聊天页：左侧会话列表（头像、名称、最后一条摘要、未读徽标）；右侧会话头显示 对方在线状态；线程按时间正序排列，己方气泡靠右用强调色，对方靠左用中性色，按天插入日期分隔； 底部输入框带附件按钮与发送，回车发送；新消息滚动到底部。响应式，深浅色一致。
design.en: Build a team chat page: conversation list on the left (avatar, name, last snippet, unread badge); a thread header with presence; chronological messages with own bubbles right in accent and peer bubbles left in neutral, plus day dividers; a composer with attach and send, Enter to send; auto-scroll to the newest message. Responsive and theme-consistent.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现聊天页：会话与消息用受控状态，发送时乐观插入本地消息并滚动到底； 输入框用 textarea 随内容增高；会话列表未读徽标随切换清零； 历史加载保持滚动锚点；尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind chat page: conversations and messages in controlled state; on send, optimistically append the local message and scroll to the end; auto-grow the textarea; clear the unread badge when a conversation is opened; keep the scroll anchor when loading history; respect prefers-reduced-motion; no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现聊天消息页。

先检查现有的消息接口、头像与输入组件，保持一致。
要求：
- 会话列表 + 线程区 + 输入区结构
- 发送消息乐观更新并滚动到底部
- 己方/对方气泡样式区分，按天插入日期分隔
- 未读徽标在打开会话后清零
- 响应式折叠为单列，键盘可操作
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the chat page in the current project.

Inspect the existing message API, avatar and input components first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Conversation list, thread area and composer layout
- Optimistic send with auto-scroll to the bottom
- Distinct own/peer bubble styles and day dividers
- Clear unread badges when a conversation opens
- Collapse to a single column responsively; keyboard operable
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
